主要内容: The document titled 's381226k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, published on March 9, 2012. It includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, which are linked to various indices and exchange rates. The Notes include Leveraged Buffered Equity Index-Linked Notes tied to the EURO STOXX 50 Index and USD/EUR exchange rate, as well as Index-Linked Notes linked to the FTSE 100 Dividend Index. The filing includes details about the pricing, settlement dates, and principal amounts of these notes. The document also contains legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The filing is part of the Bank's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
